out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the kitchen being used to store cutting boards.
violations.corrective_action: Handsink are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS instructed PIC that the handwashing sink is designated only for employee handwashing. PIC moved cutting boards from handwashing sink.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Observed plastic containers/cups used to dispense rice from rice warmers.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed plastic cups from rice warmers. EHS discussed that food utensils should be used to dispense rice, spices and etc. and must be stored with handles above the food inside the container.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Observed raw chicken stored above hummus in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC placed raw chicken below hummus in WIC.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed cut lettuce at 59F in 2 DR UC cooler, Cheesecake at 48F in Dessert display Yukon at bar that had been held for more than 24 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded cut lettuce and cheesecakes. PIC relocated other TCS food items, which had been stored in the cooler for no more than 4 hours, to another unit maintaining the proper temperature. PIC discontinued use of the 2 DR UC cooler and Dessert display Yukon at bar and contacted a technician during the inspection.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: Observed no date marking for cooked chicken and hummus in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PIC understands all cooked/prepared foods kept for more than 24 hours must be date marked. PIC has date marked the aforementioned food items accordingly.

violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. PIC discontinued use of the 2 DR UC cooler and Dessert display Yukon at bar and contacted a technician during the inspection. PIC will email to EHS proof of repair once the repair is completed.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: all squeeze bottles with different varieties of sauces throughout kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC labeled all squeeze bottles with different varieties of sauces.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: Observed employee put on gloves to work with food without washing her hands first.
violations.corrective_action: Corrected by instruction. ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness.

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. Observed employee wash their gloved hands at the hand sink.
violations.corrective_action: Employee was advised to remove gloves and wash hands properly. Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: The handwashing facility located at the bar observed blocked, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing (glass and utensils in sink).

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: all steaks and burgers.
violations.corrective_action: Update menu as discussed and email to the information provided within the next 72hrs. If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. *Provide asterisk (*) next to each item offered raw or undercooked. *At the bottom of the menu, please add: *This item may be offered raw or undercooked. Consuming raw or undercooked beef, eggs, fish, lamb, pork may increase your risk for foodborne illness”. KANOON RESTAURANT (Inspection Date: 12/10/2024) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous/toxic materials observed not labeled.
violations.corrective_action: Chemicals were poured out. Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials.

out_items.name: Sewage and waste water properly disposed

violations.title: Backflow Prevention between Sewage System & Food Equip
violations.observation: A direct connection exists between the drain line of the sanitizing basin of the 3-compartment sink and the sewer line.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a min. 1” air gap at the sanitizing basin as discussed within the next 72hrs. A direct connection may not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food, portable equipment, or utensils are placed.
